concerns.text: The project's sole required input — public Reddit comment data with subreddit, body, created_utc, and per-user identifiers — has no verified source in this round. The plan's Data Availability Gate is the correct, honest handling (no fabrication, no inappropriate substitution), but as written the pipeline cannot produce any real results: every downstream task (T2–T21) executes only against synthetic fixtures. A verified, appropriate Reddit-comments dataset (correct modality: comment text + per-user history, not e.g. submission-only or structural dumps) must be identified and cited before this plan can be executed as research rather than as code-with-fixtures. The gate should additionally specify the acceptance criteria a candidate source must meet (fields, per-user linkage, license permitting redistribution of derived aggregates) so the next round can resolve rather than re-flag the block.
